issues.title: 'New chat' does not start a clean conversation: old messages leak into the next request, the next send can be destroyed with a raw 'request_config_scope_changed' error, or is appended to the previous server chat
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #5 Error prevention (privacy/context integrity); #1 Visibility of system status; #9 Error recovery
issues.evidence: LIVE (ft-chat s13-newchat-verify.mjs, reproduced twice via header [data-testid=new-chat-button] 'New saved chat' and sidebar [data-testid=chat-sidebar-new-chat]): send 'Q1 alpha', New chat (empty state shown, shots/ft-chat/13header-a-after-new.png), send 'Q2 beta'; /chat/completions payload #1 = [user:Q1 alpha, assistant:Here's a structured answer…, user:Q2 beta]; Q1/A1 reappear and chip reads 'Chat 4 messages' (13header-b-after-q2.png); review bar persists on the new chat (11a-new-chat.png). LIVE (pu-chat p19-anchor.mjs, p19b, p20-newchat-matrix.mjs): (a) restored local chat → 'New saved chat' → Enter: toast 'Error / request_config_scope_changed', textarea emptied, no request (shots/pu-chat/19z-after-enter-1.png; also after 8s wait 19y-after-enter-wait8.png; second send fails too); (b) restored chat → Ctrl+Shift+U → send: input cleared, nothing sent (20-D-restored-ctrlshiftU.png); (c) with server chat f1221f8e open → New chat: header drops the title but send POSTs to /api/v1/chats/f1221f8e…/messages (201), thread grows 6→8 (20-B-serverchat-newchat.png); (d) fresh session → New chat → send works. CODE: useClearChat.ts:93-148 (107-118) resets messages/history/historyId/serverChatId but not the HistorySelection controller (owner/view/lease) in useHistorySelection.ts (107, 675); next send rebuilds context from the stale path (useChatActions.ts:3450-3494) or throws in chatModePipeline.ts:777-804.
issues.impact: The core 'start fresh' action is broken: unrelated or confidential topics silently send prior conversation to (possibly a different) provider; typed prompts are destroyed; replies are appended to an unrelated saved server thread, corrupting history.
issues.recommendation: Make New chat atomic inside the Playground. useClearChat already dispatches CHAT_ROUTE_REPLACEMENT_EVENT (useClearChat.ts:97), and Playground already listens for it (Playground.tsx:~990-1022). In that handler, or by exposing reset() through HistorySelectionContext so useClearChat can call useHistorySelectionContext()?.reset(), call historySelection.reset() and clearPersistedSession(); this releases the owner lease, clears view/capture/recoveries and removes the sessionStorage reference. Keep Send disabled until the selection is back to status 'idle'. Defence in depth in useChatActions (~3450): treat the selection as idle when its view.conversation_id is neither the current historyId nor the serverChatId. On any pre-stream failure, restore the composer text and map request_config_scope_changed to plain copy ('This chat changed while sending. Your message is back in the box — press Send again.'). Add regression tests (Playground.coordinator integration) for New chat followed by send from fresh, local-restored and server-loaded chats via header, sidebar '+' and Ctrl+Shift+U. Each should assert payload.messages.length===1 and no POST to the previous chat id.
issues.root_cause: hooks/chat/useClearChat.ts:93-148 resets messages/history/historyId/serverChatId but never resets the HistorySelection controller. The only reset is clearPersistedSession (hooks/usePlaygroundSessionPersistence.tsx:851-859), which New chat never calls. On the next send, useChatActions.ts:3450-3454 sees a non-idle selection and builds the turn from the stale owned view: a local chat leaks its prior turns, and a server chat is written back to the old id. After a restore, the lease is revoked (useHistorySelection.ts:98-108), so chatModePipeline.ts:777-804 throws the raw code after the composer has already been cleared.

issues.evidence: LIVE: with 'Unsaved changes' visible, clicked the left-rail Chat button: no dialog, no save request; Back to /notes; reopened note had lost the edit (shots/ft-notes/09a-unsaved-before-leave.png, 09e-reopened-second.png). issues.recommendation: (1) Flush on leave: keep a ref with the latest {isDirty, saveNote}. In the unmount cleanup of useNotesEditorState (2257-2262) call void saveNoteRef.current({showSuccessMessage:false}) when dirty and title or content is non-empty, instead of only clearing the timer. SPA navigation does not unload the page, so the request completes. (2) Backstop: write the current draft synchronously to the existing offline draft queue (persistOfflineDraft, syncState 'queued') on unmount, document visibilitychange=hidden and pagehide. The queue already auto-syncs and restores (useNotesEditorState.tsx ~1581-1690), so the draft comes back on return. (3) Mount the existing <RouteLeavePrompt when={isDirty && saveIndicator==='error'}>. It already works on web via the shim's routeChangeStart and on the extension via useBlocker, and prompts only when the flush cannot succeed (missing title, conflict). (4) Change autosave to debounce plus max-wait (e.g. 1.5s idle, at most 10s while typing) so continuous typing still saves.
issues.root_cause: useNotesEditorState.tsx:2017-2033: the autosave effect resets a 5000ms timer on every content or title change (pure debounce, NOTE_AUTOSAVE_DELAY_MS at notes-manager-utils.ts:339). Its cleanup and the unmount cleanups (useNotesEditorState.tsx:2257-2262, NotesManagerPage.tsx:2336-2342) only clear the timer and never flush. Only beforeunload is guarded (useNotesEditorState.tsx:2036-2044). Notes never mounts the existing RouteLeavePrompt (entries/shared/route-leave-prompt.tsx), so SPA route changes are unguarded on both web (Next shim) and extension (HashRouter).

issues.title: Slow models time out after 30s with no first token, even though the startup timeout is 120s, and the turn ends in an unexplained 'Turn needs review'
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Error recovery; #1 Visibility of system status
issues.evidence: LIVE (scripts/ux-review/verify-CM/v03-stop-partial.mjs hang): the completions stream was redirected to a local SSE server that opens the stream and sends no tokens for 70s. At 25s the UI still shows 'Still generating response (checkpoint 4)'; by 40s it shows 'Turn needs review … User input accepted; response not saved' with no reason (shots/verify-CM/v03-hang-25s.png, v03-hang-40s.png, hang.log). CODE: TldwChat.ts:568-581 sets startupTimeoutMs (default 120_000, chat-timeouts.ts:2) for the first visible token, but also passes streamIdleTimeoutMs=30_000 to tldwClient.streamChatCompletion. background-proxy.ts:1716 arms that transport idle timer BEFORE fetch, and it resets only when bytes arrive (1795-1806). So 30s of silence before the first token aborts the request and the 120s startup budget never applies. With the real backend, the only early bytes are tldw_metadata and stream_start (observed via curl), and heartbeats are disabled by default (Config_Files/config.txt:228 streaming_heartbeat_interval_seconds = 0; streaming_utils.py:2391). The state also survives deleting the text (shots/verify-AX/22-web-args.png). v21-slash-web.mjs: from Off, typing '/web' turns web search On before Enter (21-slash-web.png). Pressing Enter runs the command again, so '/web' followed by Enter ends in the same state it started from, i.e. a no-op. v20-slash-model-chars.mjs: typing the final 'l' of '/model' opens 'Current Chat Model Settings' and moves focus to its Close button. The user's Enter then activates Close, the modal disappears, '/model' stays in the composer and focus drops to BODY (v17/v19 logs, 17-slash-model.png). This is not a dev/StrictMode artifact: the per-keystroke flip comes from the memo recomputing on every formMessage change. CODE: Option/Playground/hooks/usePlaygroundRawPreview.ts:380-383 runs `rolePlayCompatibility = React.useMemo(() => buildRolePlayCompatibility(resolveSubmissionIntent(formMessage)))`, and buildCurrentRawRequestSnapshot calls it again at 386. resolveSubmissionIntent leads to applySlashCommand (hooks/playground/useSlashCommands.ts:204-217), which calls command.action(): setWebSearch(!webSearch), setChatMode toggle for /search, handleImageUpload for /vision, setOpenModelSettings(true) for /model. Web search or RAG mode can be on or off depending on how many characters were typed, which changes the next request's behaviour and cost without the user knowing. '/model' steals focus mid-typing, and keyboard/screen-reader users lose focus to <body>. '/vision' can open a file picker unprompted.

Add an executeSlashCommand(intent) that only usePlaygroundSubmit.ts:230 (and handleSlashCommandSelect) calls. Update usePlaygroundRawPreview.ts:380-386 to use the pure resolver. Add RTL tests: render PlaygroundForm, type '/web abc' character by character and assert webSearch is unchanged until submit; type '/model' and assert the settings modal is not open until Enter. Check the sidepanel's hooks/useSlashCommands.tsx (actions at 440/461) for the same pattern.

issues.evidence: LIVE (s17, s18): after Ctrl+S the 'Note updated' .ant-message notice has no role=status/alert or aria-live (only the icon's role=img); after keyboard delete (More → Delete → confirm) 'Note deleted · Undo' is unannounced and activeElement is <body> (shots/lens-a11y/cl-deleted-0.png). CODE: @rc-component/notification@1.2.0 and antd@6.2.1 es/message contain no aria-live/role; 10s Undo at NotesManagerPage.tsx:1160-1213; same mechanism carries chat 'Saved to Notes', 'Chat saving is incomplete' (usePlaygroundPersistence ~489-518) and copy confirmations; no app-wide announcer (only NotesGraphWorkspace has a local announce()).
issues.impact: Blind users get no confirmation that a note saved or was deleted and can't find Undo (portaled to DOM end, focus on body, gone after 10s) — a mistaken delete is effectively unrecoverable without visiting Trash.
issues.recommendation: Add an app-level announcer: an AnnouncerProvider in entries/shared/AppShell.tsx that renders two persistent sr-only regions (role=status aria-live=polite and role=alert aria-live=assertive) and exposes useAnnounce(). Wrap useAntdMessage() (hooks/useAntdMessage.ts) so success/info/warning/open call announce(text, 'polite') and error calls announce(text, 'assertive') before delegating to antd. For delete (NotesManagerPage.tsx:1160-1213), move focus to the next row's open button (or the 'Notes list' heading) after the list refetch. Show Undo as a persistent inline banner above the list, with a focusable Undo button that stays until the next action or is dismissed, and announce 'Note deleted. Undo available.' Optionally set message config duration so timers pause while the toast has focus.
issues.root_cause: apps/packages/ui/src/hooks/useAntdMessage.ts (antd message has no live-region semantics); NotesManagerPage.tsx:1160-1213 (10s Undo toast, no focus target after delete)

issues.evidence: LIVE: with no note selected the editor column shows 'Select or create a note / Choose a note from the list... / Create note / Tip: Type [[ ...' and directly below an enabled Title, Tags, toolbar and 'Write your note here...' textarea, while the header says 'New note' and 'No server save status yet'; four create entry points ('+' New note, sidebar Create note, editor Create note, Save & new) (shots/ft-notes/03a-start.png, 05a-return.png). CODE: NotesEditorPane.tsx:629-636 renders NotesEditorEmptyState in addition to the editor body; condition NotesManagerPage.tsx:2078-2084.

issues.recommendation:
Treat the blank editor as an implicit draft, which matches the intent of commit 92736e2799.
1. In NotesEditorPane.tsx:629-636, drop the large NotesEditorEmptyState block when hasActiveNotes is true. Replace it with inline guidance: textarea placeholder 'Start typing — Ctrl/Cmd+S saves to your server. Type [[ to link a note.' and title placeholder 'Untitled note'.

issues.title: Tours hang invisibly when a step's target is missing: TutorialRunner's retry remount stops Joyride from re-checking, so the skip-to-next-step fallback never runs and the tour is never marked complete
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status; #9 Help users recover from errors
issues.evidence:
LIVE (scripts/ux-review/verify-NO/02-tour-end.mjs, webui 1440x900, first /notes visit with no note selected):
- After clicking 'Next (Step 6 of 8)' I polled every 500ms for 12 s. There was no .react-joyride__tooltip, overlay or beacon. The step-8 target [data-testid=notes-section-organize] was present (y=-2, h=29).
- The console showed exactly one Joyride 'Target not mounted' warning for step 7. TutorialRunner's '[TutorialRunner] Target not found for step …' warning (TutorialRunner.tsx:280) never fired, so neither the retry-exhausted skip (setStepIndex(index+1), line 287) nor endTutorial (line 290) ran.
- localStorage tldw-tutorials completedTutorials stayed [].

CODE:
- On TARGET_NOT_FOUND, TutorialRunner.tsx:253-266 schedules setStepIndex(index) and setRetryNonce(n+1). Joyride is keyed by `${activeTutorialId}-${retryNonce}` (line 311), so every retry unmounts and remounts it.
- In react-joyride 2.9.3 (dist/index.mjs:1767-1810), TARGET_NOT_FOUND is emitted only from Step.componentDidUpdate when the store changes. A freshly mounted Joyride whose target is absent stays in the INIT lifecycle and never emits it again, so the callback chain stops.
- TutorialRunner.retry.test.tsx:48 mocks react-joyride, so the test suite cannot catch this.
- All 19 tutorial definitions share this runner, so any tour with a conditionally rendered target (Notes step 7 always) silently dies mid-tour.
issues.impact: First-time users watch the tour vanish partway through with no completion and no explanation. The tour is never recorded as completed (the Help modal keeps listing it as not done), and the auto-start flag is already set, so it will not re-offer itself. The same failure can hit any page tour whose target depends on state.
issues.recommendation:
1. In TutorialRunner.tsx, stop remounting Joyride for retries: remove retryNonce from the key.
2. On TARGET_NOT_FOUND, poll resolveTargetElement/isStepTargetReady with setTimeout up to MAX_TARGET_RETRY_ATTEMPTS. If the target appears, call setStepIndex(index), which re-renders the controlled Joyride with a changed index. If it never appears, advance with setStepIndex(index+1), or on the last step call markComplete plus endTutorial.
3. Better still, filter out steps whose targets are not ready (or that are flagged optional) when building joyrideSteps, so Joyride's progress count stays accurate.
4. Add a Playwright e2e test, or a Vitest test that uses the real react-joyride, covering a definition with one missing middle target and asserting that the next step's tooltip renders and completion is recorded.

issues.title: Save-conflict recovery is a dead end: five contradictory messages, 'Save anyway' resends the stale version and fails again, and the only exit discards your edits
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Error recovery; #3 User control; #8 Minimalist design
issues.evidence: LIVE (p09-conflict.mjs; n06-conflict.mjs two tabs; n08-offline.mjs server bump): with no local edits a remote edit yields a good banner 'This note was updated elsewhere… [Reload note]' after the 30s poll (shots/pu-notes/09a). With local + remote edits, save returns 409 and the screen shows at once: toast 'This note changed on the server. Reload notes'; pill 'Save failed Retry'; red 'Could not save — check your connection and try again.' (wrong cause); amber 'Save conflict… [Retry] [Reload server version]'; amber 'This note was updated elsewhere… [Reload note]' — three different reload labels (shots/pu-notes/09b-conflict-save.png; shots/lens-states/n06-B-conflict.png). Retry repeats 409; 'Remote changes detected (local v3/v4, remote v4/v5)… Continue anyway?' → Save anyway PUT 409 again (n08-conflict-after-retry.png, n08-after-save-anyway.png). Reload server version confirms 'Your unsaved local edits will be discarded' (09d, n06-B-reload-confirm.png). No diff, merge, keep-mine or save-as-copy; footer shows 'Version N' but no version-history endpoint/UI. CODE: confirm proceeds with stale selectedVersion (useNotesEditorState.tsx:1140-1158); 409 branch never refreshes the version (1363-1373).
issues.impact: Anyone editing in two tabs/devices or webui+extension hits a loop where the only working button throws away their edits; copy points at the network.
issues.recommendation: Replace the toast, recovery notice and stale banner with one conflict panel in NotesEditorPane, shown on 409 or when remoteVersionInfo is set while dirty. Pause autosave while it is open. Actions: 'Keep my version' (explicit overwrite: PUT with expected-version = server version, which fixes 'Save anyway' at 1140-1158 by adopting remoteVersionInfo.version); 'Use server version' (loadDetail); 'Save mine as a new note' (POST a copy); optional 'Compare' with a side-by-side diff of local vs. GET /notes/{id}. Copy should name the cause ('Changed in another tab or device at 12:25'), with no version jargon and no connection copy. Make the stale 'Reload note' open this panel instead of calling handleSelectNote. Version history and restore is a separate, larger follow-up.
issues.root_cause: useNotesEditorState.tsx:1140-1158: after the 'Save anyway' confirm, saveNote still PUTs with the stale selectedVersion (expected-version at 1317), so a 409 is guaranteed. The 409 branch (1366-1376) never adopts the server version or offers resolution. Conflict state is spread across the toast (905-933), NotesSaveStatus, notes-save-feedback, saveRecoveryNotice and remoteVersionInfo (NotesEditorPane.tsx:810-900). The stale 'Reload note' calls handleSelectNote(selectedId) (NotesEditorPane.tsx:895), which first tries to save through confirmDiscardIfDirty, so modals stack.

issues.title: A connection drop isn't noticed for up to 30s; the offline save queue doesn't engage and edits exist only in memory
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status; resilience
issues.evidence: LIVE (n08-offline.mjs): after context.setOffline(true), typing and waiting 7s gives 'Save failed' and 'Could not save — check your connection'; the 'Saved locally. Sync will resume…' path never runs. After reconnecting the edit did sync ('[typed offline]' persisted), so nothing was lost in this run (shots/lens-states/n08-offline-after-autosave.png, n08-back-online.png). CODE: offline queueing only when !isOnline (useNotesEditorState.tsx:1110); isOnline from a 30,000ms health poll (config/connection-timing.ts; useServerOnline.ts:175-186), no offline/online event listeners, failed fetches not treated as disconnect.
issues.impact: In the window before the poll notices, a crash, tab discard or accidental close loses edits even though an offline-draft feature exists.
issues.recommendation: In saveNote's catch, treat a missing HTTP status or TypeError 'Failed to fetch' as a disconnect: call persistOfflineDraft({syncState:'queued'}), clear the 'error' indicator, and show 'Saved on this device — will sync when the server is reachable'. Also trigger the connection store's one-shot check. Add window 'offline'/'online' listeners in store/connection.tsx that flip isConnected immediately and re-check on 'online'. Auto-close the global 'Can't reach your tldw server' dialog once the connection recovers.
issues.root_cause: useNotesEditorState.tsx:1110 queues offline drafts only when !isOnline. The catch block (~1364-1395) treats network failures like any error and never calls persistOfflineDraft. isOnline comes from useServerOnline (hooks/useServerOnline.ts:175-186), which polls every CONNECTED_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000 (config/connection-timing.ts:13). store/connection.tsx registers only storage and tldw:* listeners (1287-1302), not window online/offline.

issues.title: Failed autosave retries every ~5s forever (including non-retryable 400/409) and, during a conflict, opens the 'Remote changes detected' modal unprompted and takes focus
issues.heuristic: Nielsen #3 User control and freedom; #1 Visibility of system status; #9 Error recovery
issues.evidence: LIVE (v02-untitled.mjs): untitled note body; after the first 400, autosave kept POSTing while the user was idle (POST 400 at 23.1s, 28.2s, 33.4s and 38.6s: 4 in 21s; 7 identical 400s overall). LIVE (v03-conflict.mjs): after the first 409, with the user idle, the 'Remote changes detected… (local v1, remote v2)… Continue anyway?' modal opened by itself ~4s later and document.activeElement became its Cancel button. A resumed keystroke such as Space would land on Cancel (v03-b-self-modal.png). CODE: the autosave effect (useNotesEditorState.tsx:2017-2033) depends on `saving` and `saveNote`. After a failed save, `saving` returns to false, the effect re-runs and schedules another 5s save, with no backoff and no check for error class. saveNote then reaches confirmDanger (1140-1158) whenever remoteVersionInfo is set. Each cycle also calls setSaveRecoveryNotice(null) at save start (1162) and sets it again, remounting the role=alert, aria-live=assertive recovery notice (NotesEditorPane.tsx:828-842). Upside seen in v05: the loop is also what eventually queues the offline draft once isOnline flips.
issues.impact: A note that can't save (no title, conflict) hammers the server, flickers its status, and keeps re-alerting screen readers. In a conflict a modal pops up mid-thought and takes keyboard focus, which feels like the app is fighting the user.
issues.recommendation: Track the last autosave failure class in useNotesEditorState. For 4xx (400/409/422) stop auto-retrying until the content or title changes again or the user clicks Retry. For network/5xx use exponential backoff (5s, 15s, 60s) and queue the offline draft (see NS-05). Autosave must never open a modal: when remoteVersionInfo is set, skip autosave and show the conflict panel (NS-03). Interactive confirms only for explicit Save/Retry. Avoid unmounting and remounting the recovery notice on each attempt so assertive alerts fire once per new error.

group.title: Power-user navigation and keyboard workflows

strengths: Notes delete/recover is solid: single delete offers a working 10s 'Note deleted · Undo', Trash lists 'Deleted · <timestamp>' with Restore, and restore reopens the note with a 'Note restored' toast.

Notes autosave with versioning and optimistic locking: ~5s idle → 'Saved just now' and 'Version n'; Ctrl/Cmd+S saves; every save sends an expected version so conflicts are detected rather than silently overwritten; a clear 'This note was updated elsewhere… Reload note' banner appears within 30s; beforeunload guards full reloads; double submits are prevented (one POST for double-click + Ctrl+S).
Switching notes saves pending edits reliably (five rapid switches within 250ms each saved to the right note with no cross-contamination), and edits typed offline synced once the connection returned.

Editing and chat performance is good: a 25k-character note opens in ~80-135ms with ~19-22ms per keystroke in Edit and Split; a 30-message chat renders in ~0.6s, the timeline virtualizes above 100 blocks, composer input latency ~23ms.
Tagging is smooth: chip input with Enter, usage counts ('thesis (1)', 'research (32)'), a Browse tags modal with frequency sort; search and tag filtering page correctly through the server.
Notes search is genuinely full-text with term highlighting in titles and previews and an excellent no-results state ('No notes match "…"' + 'Clear search & filters') plus a Search tips popover.
Notes import is strong: multiple files, per-file note-count preview, duplicate strategy (copy / skip / overwrite), honours YAML front-matter tags and H1 titles.
The notes list error card is good: specific title, keeps search and filters, offers 'Retry connection' and 'Health & diagnostics'.

Notes 'More actions' menu is well grouped (Create / Organize / AI / Export / Delete) with icons and submenus and is fully keyboard-operable; bulk bar shows a clear count, 'Clear selection', a danger-styled Delete, and Shift-click range selection works.

Accessibility groundwork: working skip links ('Skip to main content', 'Skip to notes list', 'Skip to editor'); notes list is a real list with specific row names and aria-current; editor fields are properly named; Edit/Split/Preview use aria-pressed; save status uses role=status; chat transcript is a labelled role=log of named articles with aria-busy while streaming and an sr-only 'Response complete'; role-play drawer, shortcuts panel and keyword picker manage focus correctly; textareas use a high-contrast teal focus ring; axe found no button-name, link-name or image-alt violations.

The extension sidepanel model picker (Common/ModelSelect.tsx) already does focus management right (autofocus search, restore trigger focus) and is a ready template for the webui picker fix; sidepanel composer/message buttons meet 44px targets with aria-labels.

Answer rendering is high quality in both surfaces: headings, lists, blockquotes, syntax highlighting, LaTeX, and tables with View (fullscreen), Copy as CSV and Download CSV; message Copy gives clear check-mark feedback and copies the markdown source.

The June 2026 empty-model-picker race no longer reproduces (picker loaded on ~20 cold loads) and offers 'Usable configured models' plus 'Help me choose a model'; cockpit rails are now collapsed by default with a screen-reader note.

'Explore chat modes' cards use plain, first-timer-friendly language (General chat, Compare AI models, Character chat, Search your documents, Deep research); composer menus show each toggle's current state ('Off', 'Closed') under clear group headers and disable 'Clear conversation' when there's nothing to clear.
Composer drafts autosave with a quiet 'Draft saved' indicator in the webui and sidepanel (per-tab drafts persist across reloads), so text typed during transient failures survives.
Temporary-chat mode gives strong multi-channel feedback (label 'Temporary chat (not saved)', header tint, explanatory toast; 'Temp' button with tooltip).

Slash-command menu is discoverable with one-line descriptions; Shift+Enter newline, Shift+Esc / Ctrl+Shift+U focus the composer, Ctrl/Cmd+F opens a labelled thread search with match count and Prev/Next that handles 80-message threads without lag.

Notes Dock is a solid in-context capture surface from any page (title, tag chips, unsaved state, 'Note saved' toast, note appears in /notes immediately); the sidepanel quick-save modal is clean and fast with title prefilled and source URL shown.

Chat-to-note origin metadata is recorded ('Origin: Saved from Chat', conversation_id/message_id), 'Open conversation' reliably loads the server chat (and refuses safely when the current chat has unsaved work), and /notes?source_ref_id=<id> deep-links to a note in webui and extension.

On /chat, revisiting restores the last open server chat with its title as the tab title; sending into a server-loaded chat persists both messages; inline header rename persists to the server; chat Trash is a safe soft delete with Restore and a permanent-delete confirm; share links are read-only with role explanation and expiry.

Knowledge/Search & Context already treats Notes and Chats as retrieval sources with source-type chips, Preview / Pin / Insert per result and a saved-results tray (sidepanel adds Fast/Balanced/Thorough presets and clear timeout Retry) — a strong base for 'chat with my notes'.

'Expand in full page' carries the conversation, selected model and title into the extension full page, and 'Continue in WebUI' preserves the draft exactly — the hand-off infrastructure works and only needs merging.

Sidepanel per-chat Export produces clean, timestamped Markdown/JSON; the sidepanel command palette works in the narrow panel; the connection pill and 'Can't reach your tldw server' message are plain-language and specific.

Character chat entry is well done (header Character list, greeting picker with Reroll/Select, 'Include greeting in context', character/context chips); smart collections describe their rule in plain words ('Auto: anything tagged rag').
Extension options Notes matches the webui feature for feature; webui and options share one app shell with coherent light and dark themes; webui tab titles follow the route.
No horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 640, 768, 1024 or 1920px on either page; chat has dedicated mobile-composer viewport handling.
Clean runtime: no console errors, page errors or failed API calls across ~80 scripted sessions on webui, options and sidepanel outside the specific broken actions reported.

resolved_decisions.question: Which shortcut opens the quick switcher?
resolved_decisions.options: (a) Cmd/Ctrl+K is one universal switcher for content and commands, with a ">" prefix for commands (canonical IDEA-01). (b) Cmd/Ctrl+P (and Cmd/Ctrl+O) open a content switcher and Cmd/Ctrl+K stays the command palette (lens-visual#5, pu-notes#1).
resolved_decisions.recommendation: (a) with aliases: the header already advertises "Search ⌘K", so users expect to find things there (XP-06). Cmd/Ctrl+P and Cmd/Ctrl+O open the same switcher pre-filtered to notes and chats.
resolved_decisions.decision: Cmd/Ctrl+K is one switcher for content and commands, with a ">" prefix for commands. Cmd/Ctrl+P and Cmd/Ctrl+O open the same switcher pre-filtered to notes and chats.

resolved_decisions.question: What does Pro mode add to the composer?
resolved_decisions.options: (a) The full toolbar plus rails and token chip (canonical IDEA-11, ft-chat#5). (b) A persistent right panel instead of more toolbar buttons (lens-visual#4).
resolved_decisions.recommendation: (b): adding buttons recreates the toolbar overload in CO-03 and CO-06; one right panel can absorb today's cockpit rails (CO-04).
resolved_decisions.decision: Pro mode adds a persistent right panel instead of more toolbar buttons; the panel absorbs today's cockpit rails.

resolved_decisions.question: How many rows does the Casual composer use?
resolved_decisions.options: (a) Two rows: input + Send, then attach / Knowledge / Web / Model / More chips (lens-visual#4, canonical). (b) One row: +, input, model chip, Send (ft-chat#5).
resolved_decisions.recommendation: (a) on desktop, so Knowledge and Web stay one click away; (b) on phones and the narrow side panel, together with the bottom-sheet composer (N13).
resolved_decisions.decision: Two rows on desktop (input + Send; then attach / Knowledge / Web / Model / More). One row on phones and the narrow side panel (+, input, model chip, Send), with the bottom-sheet composer (N13).

resolved_decisions.question: What does Cmd/Ctrl+Enter do on a switcher result?
resolved_decisions.options: (a) Open in a new tab or split view (canonical IDEA-01, lens-visual#5). (b) Open the note in the Notes Dock beside the current page (pu-notes#1).
resolved_decisions.recommendation: Open beside the current page: notes in the Notes Dock now, chats in split view once S4 lands; Shift+Enter opens a new browser tab.
resolved_decisions.decision: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter opens a result beside the current page: notes in the Notes Dock now, chats in split view once S4 lands. Shift+Enter opens a new browser tab.
